title: Fix PDF 'Open' button navigation on Gallery page

requirements.summary: Fix the 'Open' button on the public gallery page so that clicking it successfully navigates the user to the PDF viewer page at /view/<shareId>
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Open' on any PDF card in the gallery navigates the browser to /view/<shareId> for that PDF
The viewer page loads and renders the PDF content after clicking 'Open'
Navigation works for all gallery entries regardless of upload order
No JavaScript errors are thrown when clicking 'Open'

file_operations.description: Fix the 'Open' button navigation by ensuring the shareId from the PDF metadata is correctly passed to the router navigation call. Verify that the button's onClick handler or Link component properly constructs the /view/<shareId> route using the shareId field from each PDF's Metadata object. Replace any broken href or navigate calls with a working TanStack Router Link component or useNavigate hook that references the correct route path.

requirements.summary: Verify that the ViewerPage correctly handles the shareId route parameter and that the chunked PDF retrieval flow completes successfully when navigated to from the gallery
acceptanceCriteria: The PDF viewer page successfully fetches and displays the PDF content when navigated to via the gallery 'Open' button
A loading progress indicator is shown while chunks are being fetched
An error message is shown if retrieval fails, rather than a blank or broken page

file_operations.description: Verify that the ViewerPage correctly extracts the shareId from the route params using TanStack Router's useParams hook and that the PDF fetch sequence (getPdfChunks → getPdfChunk loop → blob reassembly → iframe render) executes only after the actor is initialized. Add safeguards to prevent premature fetch attempts before the actor is ready. Ensure loading states are properly displayed during chunk retrieval and that error states are shown with user-friendly messages if the PDF cannot be loaded.
